rows.en: Debish: "...Welcome. How kind of you
to come all this way to see me."
Touya: "We're not letting you have your way anymore!
We'll settle this right here!"
Debish: "Heh... Humans are pitiful creatures,
patching up superficial relationships to keep their hearts from being hurt,
and merely fleeing from their circumstances.
That is why I will free humanity, and its souls, from those bonds.
The likes of you cannot stop me."
Touya: "Bullshit! Nobody wants you forcing
your own damn decisions on us!"
Debish: "...I only wish to open the way to humanity's future."
Touya: "That future isn't yours to decide!
We'll seize it with our own hands!"
Debish: "Heh... It was the same in my own Estelia.
The humans here think only of themselves too...
Nothing but masses of ego..."
Touya: "Estelia? What the hell are you talking about...?"
Debish: "It seems I've said a little too much.
Well then, shall we begin...?"
Leone: "Father..."
Debish: "To think you're the only one left...
Well, no matter. I have no further use for you.
I'll erase you along with Rayblade..."
Leone: "Father..."
Debish: "So fragile... The idea that you could stop me
with so little strength is laughable..."
Touya: "Guh..."
Debish: "This is the end..."
Ai: "Nooooo!!"
Touya: "?! Wh-what... was that light...?"
Debish: "What?! It had no effect...?
Th-this is..."
Ai: "I won't let you... I won't let you do it!
I'll... I'll protect Touya!!"
Touya: "This feeling... Burst Prana?
No, it's different... It's so warm...!!"
Yamato: "No way... Rayblade's repairing itself, nyow..."
Debish: "What is this?! How could this...
Why?! This should be impossible!"
Wenimas: "Save the world... Save Agarthia...
Only you and the person
you cherish most can do it..."
Touya: "The person I cherish most..."
Wenimas: "Yes. That's why Rayblade
has two seats..."
Touya: "I see. So that's what it means..."
Ai: "Touya...?"
Touya: "Our power, Ai. Yours and mine. That's Rayblade's power."
Ai: "Your power and mine?"
Touya: "That's right. That's why Rayblade has two seats.
So our feelings for each other can create a bond we can trust!"
Ai: "I get it! Basically, nobody can stand
against our lovey-dovey power!"
Debish: "You call it the power of love...? Nonsense!
It's nothing but an illusion!! Mere wishful thinking!
Relying on such things keeps humans from growing,
and makes them repeat the same mistakes!"
Ai: "Are you an idiot? What fun would there be
in a world where nobody could love anyone?!"
Debish: "Being led astray by those emotions
is why tragedy keeps repeating itself!"
Ai: "So you won't accept them? So you'll get rid of them?"
Debish: "Yes. Once it happens, it's too late!
That is why I will save humanity! Estelia
abandoned me, but I will never abandon this world."
Ai: "I don't know what you're talking about, but that's like
forcibly sticking umbrellas onto everyone
because it might rain tomorrow!
Nobody wants that. It's ridiculous!"
Debish: "Then defeat me with this love of yours!"
Touya: "Wh-what?!"
Yamato: "Oh!"

Yamato: "It looks like that shock
neutralized the anti-field units..."

damage him now?!"

review_batches.context: Read all 518 rows and preceding 545-row s_02d. Debish-labelled speaker claims forced spiritual liberation/human salvation, slips the Estelia name, rejects agency and threatens Leone. Ai's partner branch begins with rescue light, Rayblade repair and recalled Wenimas explanation.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the hidden occupant's name-table label Debish and self-disclosed Estelia claim without inserting library spoiler identity. Antagonist's claims about humanity/emotions are attributed ideology, not narrator psychology. Warm rescue phenomenon is explicitly questioned then distinguished from Burst Prana. Wenimas's person-you-cherish wording is not restricted to sexual love. Ai's umbrella analogy and lovey-dovey boast are intact; anti-field neutralization is reported tentatively.
